data: Spectroscopic techniques play a very important role in science and technology. It is important to understand these methods to know their advantages, applicability and limitations.  Spectroscopy plays a pivotal role in our understanding of matter, energy and their interaction; in addition, it also plays a very important role in materials characterization. A few non-spectroscopic methods will also be discussed in this course. This course will cover the principles and application of the various experimental methods and basic instrumentation.
